title: Each reader of roadmap/live/live.json rebuilds a stale file in-process; no timer, no standing manual job
why: Owner 14:36 CST Nov 18, via the consultant: the session list in roadmap/live/live.json goes stale 60 minutes after its readAt (13:05 CST) because triage refreshes it by hand, and nothing mechanizes the refresh. Consultant asked at 14:36 CST whether a step existed; none did (triage 11 read the steps naming the live file: none covers the refresh).
source: owner 14:36 CST Nov 18 via the consultant; triage 11 search of roadmap/data/steps at 14:37 CST
note: Owner 14:39 CST Nov 18 (via the consultant, word for word): triage owns it, lands it itself. Triage merges it with its own test-author, builder and reviewer agents (not a coordinator lane). End state, built and merged (REST): (1) drop the standing job 'refresh the live file when runner 10 asks'. (2) Each reader (skills/roadmap/build.py page bake; merge --idle-lanes --live; merge --ledger) checks the file's age against STALE_LIVE_MINUTES (one constant, one home); when stale it rebuilds in-process from list_sessions plus REST open PRs, reusing roadmap/livework/make_live.py and sess_map.py (extend that home, no second builder). (3) Rule outcomes-mechanize-rules: on demand inside a running process; no timer, no new long-lived process; the record states the cost (one list_sessions plus one REST page set per stale read); a test proves no rebuild when fresh. (4) A reader that cannot rebuild (no session API, for example a local session) prints the file's age and 'stale', never reads it as current. (5) Test-author writes red tests first (stale triggers rebuild; fresh does not; failed rebuild reports stale), then a builder; review per roles-review-cap-three (guard yes for the merge-tool readers). (6) The page names the snapshot's age wherever it is shown. Prior-work search first (steps merge-runs-idle-lanes, idle-lanes-names-live-source, triage-fills-landed-pulls). The by-hand recipe cost 84 tool calls (commit 3d585f91d9, 14:38 CST). Owner pick c on page item 976, saved 18:32 CST Nov 18 (read 18:34 CST): the refresh keeps non-archived session rows, plus an archived row that an open pull request's footer or a live step's lane names.
